meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编码前产出决策完备的实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不先理清方案就写代码总返工。
copy.tagline_en: Produce a decision-complete work plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear work plan before starting implementation.

howto.what: 触发后 Claude 会宣布“ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!”，然后作为规划顾问工作：先做只读调研，把模糊或庞大的需求收敛成一份决策完整的工作计划，写清路径、范围与禁止项。未经你同意不写最终计划；获批后也只写计划文件，不碰产品代码，实施由你另开会话执行。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确要求 ulw-plan 流程，或要求在实施前先做计划时才生效；只是说“直接做X”不会自动进入。一旦激活，后续哪怕说“直接做”，也会按“先规划”来办。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给登录限流先写一份实施计划。
say.note: 进入后先做只读调研，不会直接改代码。

say.text: 先别实现，用 ulw-plan 把这次重构完整规划出来。
say.note: 未获批前不会产出正式计划与代码。

say.text: 按 ulw-plan 为导出功能规划步骤、范围与禁止项。
say.note: 批准后才会写入完整计划文件。

howto.what_en: Claude announces "ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!" and becomes a planning consultant: it explores read-only, then writes ONE decision-complete plan (paths, scope, must-not-haves). It won't finalize before explicit OK and never edits code—only plan files; execution is a separate session.
howto.when_en: Only explicit requests for ulw-plan or a plan before implementation trigger it; a plain 'just do X' won't activate it. Once active, later 'do X' requests are treated as 'plan X'.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to write an implementation plan for login rate-limiting first.
say_en.note: It explores first, no direct code changes.

say_en.text: Don't implement yet—use ulw-plan to lay out the full plan for this refactor.
say_en.note: No official plan before your approval, and no code.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to map export steps, scope, and forbidden items.
say_en.note: The complete plan is written only after approval.
